lip_semantics: Target vertical lip separation / horizontal mouth width. Native model has no universal bounds; local official UI exposes0..0.8. This version permits only0/.2/.35/.5; attained ratio is not guaranteed.
semantic_text_role: English descriptions are provenance metadata; actual model input is numeric retargeting, not language
